request_user:
Fact: data_scope
What to find: Scope and main characteristics of the training data (domains, languages, geography, modality coverage).
Card sections that often contain it: Training Data

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: The SFT corpus draws on four sources: publicly available permissively licensed datasets, internally generated synthetic data targeting reasoning, tool calling, and chain-of-thought, agentic traces across diverse tasks, and curated human-authored data. The base model was pre-trained on a large-scale English as well as multilingual corpus. Fine-tuning data is mostly English, with some multilingual data covering the supported languages.
quotes: For all the three, 3B, 8B and 30B models, the training corpus comprises four sources: (1) publicly available datasets under permissive licenses, (2) internally generated synthetic data targeting reasoning, tool calling, and chain-of-thought capabilities, (3) agentic traces collected across a diverse range of tasks, and (4) a curated selection of human-authored data.
Granite-4.2-8B builds on [Granite-4.1-8B-Base](https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-4.1-8b-base), which was pre-trained on a large-scale English as well as multilingual corpus.
Granite 4.2 models are primarily finetuned using instruction-response pairs mostly in English, but also multilingual data covering the supported languages listed above.
